title: Basis expanded polynomial
statement: For a nonzero natural number $\ell$ and a binary cube $\gamma\in\mathbb{F}_2^{n\ell}$, define a polynomial over the binary extension field of degree $\ell$ by $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1} c_i X^{i+1}$, where $c_i$ is the grouped coefficient associated with $\gamma$ and index $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $\gamma$ is a binary cube of length $n\ell$
caveat: The definition of `basisExpandedGroupedCoefficient` is not supplied, so the coefficients cannot be spelled out further.
